verdict.rationale: Datalab is API-first, so it can run without a UI. It has a documented official CLI for converting documents from the command line, a Python SDK, REST endpoints for convert, extract and segment, and webhooks so jobs don't need polling. It also offers an API health check and deployable on-prem containers with a Helm chart, all of which fit unattended or CI-driven automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless guidance (e.g. pipeline examples, non-interactive auth via environment variables, exit-code behavior), a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
